keywords.nuance: さらに adds extra information or introduces an additional degree, often stronger than 「また」.
keywords.example: 雨が強くなりました。さらに、風も強いです。
keywords.exampleTranslation: The rain got stronger. What's more, the wind is also strong.

commonPitfall.title: Common Pitfall
commonPitfall.body: Use さらに for extra addition or escalation, not to start a story like それから.

questions.prompt: その料理は美味しい。さらに、安いです。
questions.hint: Another positive point is being added.
questions.answer: That dish is delicious. On top of that, it's cheap.

questions.prompt: 彼は丁寧です。さらに、時間も守ります。
questions.hint: The second clause adds extra praise.
questions.answer: He is polite. He is also punctual.

questions.prompt: 雨が降っています。さらに、気温も下がります。
questions.hint: Something worsens with an additional effect.
questions.answer: It is raining, and the temperature is dropping further.

questions.prompt: この辞書は役に立つ。さらに、例文がたくさんあります。
questions.answer: This dictionary is useful. In addition, it has many example sentences.

productionQuestions.prompt: The meal was good, and on top of that, the service was excellent.
productionQuestions.hint: Use さらに to add a second positive point.

referenceAnswers.answer: 料理がおいしくて、さらにサービスもとても良かった。
referenceAnswers.note: Adds an extra praise point with さらに.

referenceAnswers.answer: 食事は良かったです。さらに対応も丁寧でした。
referenceAnswers.note: Uses さらに with a pause between clauses.

productionQuestions.prompt: His plan is clear, and it even has a backup.
productionQuestions.hint: Use さらに for another supporting feature.

referenceAnswers.answer: 計画は明確で、さらに予備案もあります。
計画は分かりやすい。さらに、代替案も準備しました。

productionQuestions.prompt: The problem was fixed, and even harder cases are now possible.
productionQuestions.hint: Use the addition of extra difficulty.

referenceAnswers.answer: 問題は直って、さらに難しいケースにも対応できます。
referenceAnswers.note: Natural business style use of さらに.

referenceAnswers.answer: 修正できたので、さらに難しい条件にも進めます。

productionQuestions.prompt: The hotel is clean, and the location is also very convenient.
productionQuestions.hint: Use さらに to stack positives.

referenceAnswers.answer: このホテルは清潔で、さらに立地もとても便利です。
部屋はきれいで、それに立地もとてもよいです。
referenceAnswers.note: Another natural way to add another quality.
